title: Aloo Paratha
subtitle: Spiced potato-stuffed flatbread
excerpt: Soft wheat dough is filled with spiced mashed potato, then rolled flat and cooked in a hot dry pan with ghee until golden and blistered. Aloo paratha is a Punjabi breakfast staple that works equally well as a quick dinner. Serve with yoghurt and pickle.
sourceNotes: Based on the classic Punjabi aloo paratha. The potato filling must be completely dry or it will tear the dough during rolling.

recipe.makeAheadNotes: Make the dough and filling separately up to a day ahead. Assemble and cook fresh.

content.text: The potato filling must be completely lump-free and fully dry before stuffing. Any moisture will steam and burst through the dough when you roll it.
Make the dough. Put the flour in a bowl with a pinch of salt. Add the warm milk gradually, mixing as you go. Knead for 5 minutes until smooth. Cover and rest for 15 minutes.
Make the filling. Mix the mashed potato, grated onion, cumin seeds, green chilli, ginger, and coriander together. Season with salt.
Divide the dough into 8 equal balls. Divide the filling into 8 portions.
Flatten one dough ball. Place a portion of filling in the centre. Bring the edges up around it and pinch to seal. Press gently into a disc.
Roll out on a floured surface to about 18cm in diameter. Take your time and roll gently. If the dough tears, press it back together.
Heat a dry frying pan over medium-high heat. Add the paratha. Cook for 90 seconds until small bubbles appear and the underside looks dry.
Flip and brush the cooked side with ghee. Cook for 90 seconds. Flip again, brush with more ghee, and press gently with a spatula.
Repeat with the remaining parathas. Keep finished ones wrapped in a clean cloth to stay warm.

items.symptom: Filling is bursting through the dough
items.cause: Too much filling or dough rolled too thin
items.fix: Use less filling and roll more carefully next time.

items.cause: Dough not rested or cooked on too high heat
items.fix: Rest dough 15 minutes and reduce heat slightly.

items.symptom: Filling is wet and soggy inside
items.cause: Onion not squeezed dry before mixing in
items.fix: Squeeze grated onion in a cloth before using.
